title: Newly Established Film Production Company Equity Stake For Sale in Dubai, UAE
tagline: The business is currently in the pre-revenue phase. - Once the required investment is secured, it will commence filming and production of an epic historical feature film that will combine cinema, artificial intelligence, and Middle Eastern cultural heritage. - The film will target global audiences aged 18–54, including viewers interested in historical and mythological cinema and MENA audiences. - The original screenplay has been completed and registered with the Writers Guild of America. - Story and creative development have also been finalized. - Storyboarding, visual development, character design, world-building, casting, and AI production testing are currently underway. - The production will be led by an established UAE-based company with experience in audiovisual production and international cultural initiatives.
